name: visual-ai-architect
description: AI-powered visual development environment with flowchart-based code generation

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=frontend && npm run build --workspace=backend && bash scripts/run-tests-clean.sh && bash scripts/check-training.sh
scripts.// check:training note: build ends with check-training.sh (FULL gate, no --quick): py_compile of the training-pipeline Python scripts + the tsc_check concurrency test (48 calls) + the probe self-check (--fail-on-probe-clean, 144 calls across 3 rounds, fails CI if the shared-scratch regression probe stops detecting the bug it guards). Full gate runs in ~22s. Requires python3; self-skips (exit 0) only when tsc (node_modules/typescript) is unavailable. The --quick variant remains available via make check-training-quick / bash scripts/check-training.sh --quick.
